arguments.question: Stage 3 attempt 1 (baseline) has a single hard violation: tournament 1cd9bcac hosted by Frisk Asker has an eligible U11 team that never participates. A repair option exists to remove that tournament entirely. Automated re-optimization (attempts 2 and 3, including with move_dates/move_hosts/move_slots enabled) did not fix this and instead introduced dozens of new participation_target_exceeded hard violations, with attempt 3 clearly regressing further (unresolved_obligations_count 3->10, temporal.offenders_count 1->17) and not dominating the baseline. optimize_plan is no longer offered at this decision point. Should we (a) apply the remove_tournament repair to clear the baseline's one hard violation and proceed, (b) author a scoped operator waiver for this specific host_team_missing case, or (c) provide different guidance (e.g. manual host/team reassignment) before we continue?

action.rationale: Automated optimization attempts regressed rather than improved the plan; escalating to the operator instead of applying a worse candidate or silently keeping a plan with an unresolved hard violation.

result.rationale: Automated optimization attempts regressed rather than improved the plan; escalating to the operator instead of applying a worse candidate or silently keeping a plan with an unresolved hard violation.
